ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Claude API key from the Anthropic Console (organization workspace with a spend limit). Needs data approval: bid documents and the Specifications Table are sent to the Claude API.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated addresses outside @vitrodc.com that may sign in, e.g. your own claude.ai or Gmail address.

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated addresses that may upload the Specifications Table and Reference Register. Each must also be able to sign in.
